text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired -> PD#95321. Reason: BurstBackflow quota-misdirect on rate-router in us-west. Automatic page to oncall. Logs indicate quota map lookup returned nil for several tokens, causing immediate 429s.

maria: acked. I’m oncall for the window, taking initial triage. tagging @sam for runtime/limiter.

pagerduty: Incident acknowledged by maria. Escalation to secondary in 3m if unacked.

sam: seeing a sharp spike in limiter errors from the rate-router: `quota_map_lookup: key miss -> default_quota=0` and downstream limiter returns 429.

sam: quick log snippet:
```
2026-03-15T08:10:12Z rate-router[pid=1123] WARN lookup tenant for token xxxxx returned nil
2026-03-15T08:10:12Z limiter[pid=3344] ERROR enforce quota tenant_id=none -> 429 token=xxxxx
2026-03-15T08:10:12Z router[pid=1123] INFO routed request -> fallback=false
```

maria: any deploys around 08:05 UTC?

sam: nope, no deploys in the window per release-bot. This looks like a runtime config or mapping service flake.

lee: paging in from infra. I can query the quota-mapper service and the cache tier. running: `kubectl -n inference logs quota-mapper-0`

lee: output shows repeated `GET /mappings?shard=us-west` 500 errors from mapping-db. cache-populate failing -> empty map served.

maria: confirmed customer impact: support-bot flagged 18 customers with 429s, 3 enterprise tenants saw sustained failures ~8m. Escalating to SOC for customer comms.

support-bot: created ticket SUP-4721 for the most affected customer (acme-inc). Assigned to customer-svcs.

sam: proposed mitigation: enable routing fallback to `shared-burst` bucket and flip quota-mapper to return last-known good snapshot. Two steps: 1) enable soft-fallback in router, 2) restore snapshot in quota-mapper.

sam: commands:
```
# enable soft fallback in router (temporary)
apictl route set rate-router --region us-west --soft-fallback=true

# restore last-known good mapping snapshot
kubectl exec -n inference quota-mapper-0 -- /opt/quota-mapper/restore_snapshot /snapshots/2026-03-15T07:58:00.json
```

maria: sam, can you run 1 then 2? I’ll coordinate PD notes and customer comms.

sam: running step 1 now.

sam: ✅ soft-fallback enabled. Observability: immediate drop in 429s by ~60% within 30s.

sam: running restore snapshot now.

sam: restore succeeded. quota-mapper logs: `restore complete -> 12k mappings loaded`.

lee: cache repopulating; mapper health back to OK.

maria: can folks confirm error rate across US-West for the last 5m vs baseline?

sam: baseline error rate ~0.2%, spiked to 12% at peak. After mitigations it's down to 0.7% and trending to baseline.

pagerduty: Incident acknowledged by maria. Secondary escalation cancelled.

maria: good. I'll mark incident as mitigated. Lee, please keep an eye on mapper replicas for 30m. Sam, put a short rollback plan in case snapshot restore regresses.

lee: on it. Adding extended healthcheck and alert suppression for the transient errors so we don't double-page while we stabilize.

devon: assigning postmortem owner: devon. Will collect timeline and root-cause analysis. Quick notes: probable root cause = mapping-db transient 500s causing empty mapping to be served; lack of defensive default mapping behavior led to hard 0 quotas.

maria: action items
- devon: postmortem + RCA (ETA 72h)
- sam: add guard in rate-router to treat missing mapping as "no-change" rather than 0 quota (PR + test)
- lee: add quorum check to quota-mapper so it doesn't serve empty snapshots; improve healthcheck and autoscale for mapping-db
- support: send interim customer updates for SUP-4721 and related tickets

support-bot: SUP-4721 updated: interim update sent to acme-inc.

maria: incident resolved for now — switching to monitoring mode. Will close PD incident once we confirm 30min stable window. Great quick work. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident status changed -> MITIGATED at 2026-03-15T08:17:30Z by maria. PD#95321 remains open for post-incident review.

maria: handing off to lee at 08:30 PT for extended watch. If any regression, pd escalate to devon.

lee: ack and taking watch.

incident-bot: Incident closed at 2026-03-15T08:30:50Z (duration 20m29s). Follow-ups recorded in the postmortem backlog.

devon: I'll schedule the postmortem and ping infra/product for follow-ups. Thanks all.
